children: The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 2000 GMT on Friday:
** Poste Italiane
has secured a 66.6% stake in Telecom Italia's (TIM) share capital, Reuters calculations based on stock exchange data showed, at the end of the main phase of the state-backed group's takeover offer.

** Azerbaijan's Bank Respublika has agreed to acquire AccessBank from a group of international financial institutions in a deal that will give AccessBank's current shareholders a combined 25% stake in Bank Respublika, the banks said.
**  Dutch private equity firm Waterland said it is no longer in concert with UK-based Giacom to make an offer for British telecom company Gamma Communications
** Colgate-Palmolive
is exploring a sale of certain mass-market personal care brands, including Softsoap, Irish Spring and Speed Stick, sources familiar with the matter told Reuters.
** Private equity firms Francisco Partners and KKR
have agreed terms to buy minority stakes in Italian software company TeamSystem from its main investor Hellman & Friedman, three people familiar with the matter said.
**  Recruiter SThree
unanimously rejected an unsolicited all-cash takeover approach from U.S.-based Circle8 Group
, saying the proposal significantly undervalues the British company and its future prospects.
** CVC Capital Partners has entered final talks to buy the EQT-owned mainland China business of contact lens maker Ginko International, four people with knowledge of the matter said.
** Cyprus-based oil and gas company Energy Holdings
has agreed to buy deepwater drilling contractor Ventura Offshore
to create a larger platform for cash generation, shareholder distribution and growth, the Oslo-listed companies said on Friday.
** Online vehicle auctioneer Copart
on Thursday agreed to acquire peer ACV Auctions
in an all-cash deal of about $1.9 billion, marking its entry into dealer-to-dealer wholesale remarketing.
** Shell's
North American unit said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its interests in a gas-fired power plant complex in Rhode Island to Constellation Energy
for $715 million, while also expanding into the lucrative U.S. Mid-Atlantic power market.
